headline: The Government Too Notices Fiscal Drag | L. Rizzo and A. Zanardi
summary: Statistics Indonesia reported the Farmer Exchange Rate (NTP) rose to 127.84 in July 2026, up 0.15% from June. The index measures farmers' purchasing power relative to their costs.
why: The farmer exchange rate tracks rural purchasing power by comparing farm-gate prices with household and production costs, a gauge of agricultural income health in Indonesia.
